evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 8 semesters

notes: tuition: the only supplied page for this programme (studyfinder) states no self-financed tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students and mentions only the Stipendium Hungaricum state scholarship; no fee could be quoted for this programme, so it is left out. intakes: no dated application deadline, opening date or start date is stated on the supplied pages, so the fact is left out. applicationChannel: the supplied pages do not name an application platform or route for a self-financed foreign applicant, so no channel could be quoted. The Admissions page (https://lkk.uni-sopron.hu/en_GB/admissions-1) lists 'Admission Process – BSc' and 'Admission Process – Stipendium Hungaricum' links but the texts of those pages were not supplied.

evidence.quote: Requirements High school diploma, TOEFL or IELTS language exam, Attestation of Language Proficiency in case of English language former studies Language requirement: B2, TOEFL iBT min. 66 points, IELTS min. 6.0

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission en ligne (oral) est obligatoire ; il évalue la langue, la motivation et la présentation. Vérifiez les modalités auprès du coordinateur.
note.en: An online oral entrance interview is required; it assesses language, motivation and presentation. Check the details with the coordinator.

evidence.quote: Entrance examination requirements: The entrance exam happens in the frame of an online-interview with the participation of the AC.
